panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Islamic note: riba (رِبَا) is forbidden (Qur'an 2:275: Allah has permitted trade and forbidden riba). Islamic finance uses partnership (mushārakah, مُشَارَكَة) and cost-plus sale (murābaḥah, مُرَابَحَة) instead. Exam cash flow questions may show interest payments: we calculate them as knowledge of how businesses work, not as something to take.
